svg.aria-label: Stack. Front: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Radix UI. Back: Node.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB. Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel, Linux.
